FILTER_FILE.description: An optional text file containing SEC EDGAR feed instructions. It may specify tickers, CIKs, form types (including 13F-HR institutional holdings), excluded forms, amendment handling, an EDGAR full-text query, a filing-date window, relevance criteria, requested 10-K/10-Q sections, exhibit handling, and a positive note limit or no limit. If not set or empty, the recipe performs a market-wide 8-K run for the resolved window with the default 20-note limit.

SEC_CONTACT_EMAIL.description: A contact email included in the SEC EDGAR User-Agent so automated requests identify a responsible contact.
